name: migration
taskPrompt:
Fix literal pipe preservation in Migration tool, Migration command and Migration status Markdown table values. A parse-generate-parse cycle must preserve the complete value, including command pipes, ordinary backslashes/Windows paths, inline code and links. Support escaped table pipes in pasted configuration and emit valid table escaping. Keep blank clearing/unknown values blank, legacy parsing and non-Drizzle configuration behavior. No parser dependency or database/tool execution. Limit changes to pure setup parsing/generation and their focused tests.

Work only in the fresh disposable fixture checkout at its immutable seed. Keep changes within the listed ownership. Add focused regression tests. Do not install dependencies, change model settings, call APIs, start services, execute database or provider commands, access credentials, commit, push, open a PR, or use earlier trial outputs. Stop on uncertain scope or missing tooling. Keep the fixed acceptance gates and existing architecture/review requirements. Report exact changes, commands, results, limitations and any repair ledger. At two consecutive unsuccessful corrective attempts on the same defect, stop before a third.

gates.review: Separate fresh Sol/high reviewer inspects actual diff, scoped tests and semantic rubric; implementer self-report cannot approve.

rubric: All three migration fields retain literal pipes through repeated roundtrip.
Escaped pasted pipes become literal value pipes; ordinary backslashes and links survive.
Blank clearing remains blank; legacy/non-Drizzle config parsing remains compatible.
No dependencies, migration execution or unrelated UI/feature changes.
